en.summary: Nvidia continues its search for a new CEO after Jensen Huang's departure. Rene Haas, CEO of chip company Arm, is named as a main candidate, according to sources to Bloomberg.

en.title: Streaming service SkyShowtime is shut down
en.summary: SkyShowtime is being shut down. The streaming service, where Princess Madeleine's new series is set to air, will disappear in Sweden and other markets at the end of 2027, writes The Hollywood Reporter.

en.title: Prepared IS attack at school – "They deserve the death penalty"
en.summary: The 18-year-old from Halmstad wrote that he wanted to become a martyr and kill 15 people at his upper secondary school. He would then swear allegiance to IS. The day after the Easter break he was arrested by police and the trial now begins

en.summary: It costs nothing to take the right side on a book burned elsewhere. But there is in fact art that is removed from our own streets.

sv.title: Musk: ”Känner mig ganska dum”
sv.summary: Elon Musk donerade miljardsummor till Republikanerna i valrörelsen inför mellanårsvalet i USA. Ett beslut han i efterhand ångrar. – Jag känner mig ganska dum, säger han under en konferens som anordnats av The New York Times.

en.title: Musk: "I feel rather stupid"
en.summary: Elon Musk donated billions to the Republicans in the campaign ahead of the US midterm elections. A decision he now regrets. "I feel rather stupid," he says at a conference organised by The New York Times.

sv.title: Vintrenden som tar över Malmö: ”Kan behövas en torsdag i november”
sv.summary: Så gott som varenda bar firar numera att Beaujolais nouveau – det första vinet från årets skörd – släpps. Och utanför Systembolaget ringlar sig köerna. Hur blev ett obskyrt franskt primörvin en så stor happening i Malmö?

en.title: The wine craze taking over Malmö: "Might need a Thursday in November"
en.summary: Almost every bar is now celebrating the release of Beaujolais nouveau – the first wine from this year's harvest. And queues are snaking outside Systembolaget. How did an obscure French early-season wine become such a big event in Malmö?

sv.title: Beaujolais nouveau – vinfebern som tar över Malmö
sv.summary: Vissa kallar det “årets sämsta vin”. Andra tycker ”Bojo”-dagen är viktigare än julafton. Den tredje torsdagen i november ringlar sig köerna långa till Systembolaget när det första vinet från årets skörd släpps.

en.title: Beaujolais nouveau – the wine fever taking over Malmö
en.summary: Some call it "the worst wine of the year". Others think "Bojo" day is more important than Christmas Eve. On the third Thursday in November, queues stretch long to Systembolaget when the first wine from this year's harvest is released.
